one_liner: Email marketing and marketing automation platform; the Marketing API lets developers manage audiences, campaigns, and automations.

auth.evidence_quote: You should use an API key if you're writing code that tightly couples your application data to your Mailchimp account data; if you ever need to access someone else's Mailchimp account data, you should use OAuth 2.
auth.notes: Both API key and OAuth2 are documented; OAuth2 is the vendor-recommended path for accessing other people's accounts.

access.evidence_quote: what you can do with the API depends on what level of Mailchimp plan you have
access.notes: A Mailchimp account (free tier exists) is sufficient to get API credentials; some functionality may be limited by plan tier but no separate approval gate is documented.

api.evidence_quote: You can authenticate requests using either your API key or an OAuth access token, depending on your use case.
api.notes: Marketing API resource index (lists, campaigns, automations, reports, etc.) is broad; did not verify official MCP within call budget.

verdict.rationale: Free Mailchimp account plus OAuth2 gives immediate self-serve access to other users' accounts with no additional review gate documented.
